en: I have spent my whole life painting caves, hoping one day to paint Cobalion in one. It has never come.
That Pokémon of yours... it can't be! Cobalion, here, standing before me!
It walks beside you of its own will. So it has found a person it can trust after all.
That is what I'll paint, then: not the Pokémon alone, but the two of you, side by side.
My painting of Cobalion is nearly done. I wonder what it would make of it, if it ever came to look.
